prompt: Hibernate Search MassIndexer MySQL JDBC idFetchSize value
answer:
For MySQL, set the MassIndexer’s `idFetchSize` to `Integer.MIN_VALUE`:

```java
massIndexer.idFetchSize(Integer.MIN_VALUE);
```

This prevents the MySQL JDBC driver from preloading the entire primary-key result set into memory. Hibernate Search documents that MySQL may benefit from this special value. ([Hibernate Search 7.2 API](https://docs.hibernate.org/search/7.2/api/org/hibernate/search/mapper/orm/massindexing/MassIndexer.html))

Note: a search result reports that MariaDB rejected this value with `invalid fetch size`; the documented recommendation is specifically for MySQL.
